no-restricted-globals.name: Date
no-restricted-globals.message: Use Temporal for calendar time and the Clock service for now(). See ADR 0005.

no-restricted-properties.message: Use the Clock service instead of Date.*. See ADR 0005.

eslint-js/no-restricted-syntax.message: throw inside Effect.gen becomes a defect. Use yield* Effect.fail(...). See ADR 0005.
Do not throw. Return Effect.fail(...) or Effect.die(...). See ADR 0005.
